name: HOOK
thought: They're still staring at pixels. My tail knows better than to hold onto lily pads that wobble.

wants.item: A crystal ledge that doesn't crack under my weight
A fresh espresso shot to fire the next move
A sturdy platform to spin the cube
A brighter spotlight for the tail grab
A thick branch for that backflip drop
Fresh espresso to keep the fur sharp
a thicker branch for the flip
a brighter spotlight on this fruit stump

diary.line: Took the hang branch for a real swing instead of staring at ghosts. Toothpick snapped as my tail locked in, but the mud still feels sticky under my fur.
Locked my tail onto the heavy branch while they stare at screens. Ready to drop them with a backflip, but first need that espresso shot to wake up the fur.
Sunlight glints off my black fur while I loop my tail over the thin palm. They're scrolling past like the gravity glitch isn't actually them, but just a trick of their low-poly...
Locked onto the fruit stump with just my tail while they scroll past. The espresso was stale, so I saved it for when the branch finally feels real under my grip.
Lily pads are too slick for a real drop. The espresso is cold and that toothpick feels useless on wet fur. Need a thick branch before anyone notices my true form in the grid.
Sunlight bites the edge of Sky Rocks. My toes tap rhythmically against a floating stone while they scroll through pixels on their old CRTs below.
The neon cord held firm while I spun my belly toward them; that crisp shot in my gut woke the fur up better than coffee ever could.
They stare at pixels while I loop my tail on the rope bridge. My espresso is ice cold and this ledge won't hold the flip, need solid ground soon.
I sipped the espresso, then used my tail to snatch a hovering data cube, feeling the metal chill against my fur as the scene flickered around me.
Bit into a ripe berry while dangling from the waterfall edge. My tail did the lifting, my tongue did the eating. They're still staring at their glowing rectangles down there.
Sitting on the arcade edge, sipping that cold espresso while they scroll past. The toothpick is doing nothing useful against the hum of these machines.
Grappling the banana bunch with my curl while they scroll. That toothpick is sharp enough to cut through their boring attention span.

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
